slides.title: Stop ending the day with your to-do list. Read your done list.
slides.sub: Your brain only remembers the undone

slides.title: Write what you did, not what's left
slides.body: Every evening, list what got done. Even the tiny stuff.

slides.title: Start with the first thing
slides.body: Got up, made coffee, fed the cat. Yes, those go on the list.

slides.title: Keep it where you'll see it
slides.body: By the bed or on the fridge. Not in a notes app you'll forget.

slides.title: Read it on hard days
slides.body: When your brain says 'nothing got done,' the list says otherwise.

slides.title: Add a tiny reward
slides.body: Five things on the list? Pick something small from your reward list.

slides.title: You did more today than your brain is giving you credit for.
Want a done list to print?
slides.body: Grab the Tidy Brain Printable Pack for the "I did it" list and reward menu. Link in bio.

caption:
My to-do list made me feel behind. My done list made me feel human.
What's one thing you did today?
